title: Save the Girl Draw
description: Sketch instant protective shields and clever paths to guard the heroine from falling hazards, rolling boulders, and mischievous traps.
controls: Draw a continuous line to block incoming dangers or guide the character safely past traps.

zh-CN.title: 画线救女孩
zh-CN.description: 超火益智物理画线救女孩：危急关头一笔画线挡住滚石毒蜂与机关陷阱，用你的神笔操作护送女孩安全通关！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动画出线条挡住高空坠物与陷阱机关，坚持倒计时结束即成功过关。
